description: Erase all disks of a dedicated server so an operating system can be installed afterwards. No operating system is installed by this tool (osTemplateId is only validated); install one by mounting a catalog ISO with mount_dedicated_install_media. All data on the server is lost. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

osTemplateId.description: Optional catalog template id; only validated, nothing is installed (the reset only wipes the disks).

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: erase_dedicated_server_disks
title: Erase Dedicated Server Disks
